features.description: Showcase generator + per-target artifact matrix + CLI flag wire-throughs + redactor + sanitization extension. Build `dontpanic showcase regen` CLI subcommand at scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/showcase/__init__.py. Declarative showcase config: list of per-target {repo_key: str, label: str, repo_root: Path, description: str, supported_artifacts: frozenset[str] ⊆ {architecture, validate_plans_strict, drift}, has_dontpanic_plans: bool, has_committed_architecture_json: bool}. v0 ships 4 targets: dontpanic (all 3 artifacts), agent-conventions (architecture + validate_plans_strict if plans dir exists), axiom (architecture only), and ONE of {spindine, glam} (architecture + validate_plans_strict if plans dir exists — operator picks at lock or generation time). For each target with an existing repo_root, invoke: (a) architecture.regen(repo_root, with_html=True) writing to docs/showcase/<repo_key>-architecture.{html,json}; (b) doctor's validate-plans-strict probe (when supported) writing JSON summary to docs/showcase/<repo_key>-validate-plans.json; (c) doctor's architecture-drift probe (when supported, currently DontPanic only) writing JSON summary to docs/showcase/<repo_key>-drift.json. Includes NEW CLI flag wire-throughs (small surface): `--plans-root <path>` on validate-plans-strict probe (the underlying function already accepts custom plans_root per Plan 3 F003; just need CLI flag) + `--architecture-json <path>` on architecture-drift probe (the function reads docs/architecture/architecture.json relative to repo root today; add flag for external invocation). Redactor pass over every generated artifact: scrub absolute paths to repo-relative form; redact `/Users/<user>/`, `~/`, etc. Atomic writes (write to tmp + rename). Update scripts/sanitization_check.py ALLOWED_PREFIXES to include `docs/showcase/`. Missing target_repo_root → emit `target not found at <path>; skipping` and continue with remaining targets. NO runtime code copied into target repos; the generator only reads target files via existing Plan 4 / Plan 3 capabilities + the new CLI flags.
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture.py + scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py (validate_plans_strict + architecture_drift probes) + scripts/sanitization_check.py end-to-end. Map exactly where the new --plans-root + --architecture-json flags plug in (per Plan 3 F003: validate_plans_strict() function already accepts plans_root arg; per Plan 4 F003: architecture-drift probe reads from a fixed path today — need flag).

Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/showcase/__init__.py as new subpackage. Module entry: showcase_main(argv: list[str]) -> int. Subcommands: `regen` (main flow) + future-room for `status` (showcase index summary; v0 ships regen only).

Create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/showcase/config.py with TargetSpec dataclass (frozen=True): {repo_key: str, label: str, repo_root: Path, description: str, supported_artifacts: frozenset[str], has_dontpanic_plans: bool, has_committed_architecture_json: bool} + DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_CONFIG list. v0 default config: dontpanic (../DontPanic — but the canonical regen path is the CWD; the default invocation operates relative to repo root not external path for DontPanic itself), agent-conventions (../agent-conventions), axiom (../axiom), spindine (../SpinDineSwift) AND/OR glam (../Glam). Operator picks SpinDine OR Glam via --target=spindine or --target=glam at generation time (or `--all` to attempt both). Document the assumed checkout layout (sibling dirs under ~/Documents/GitHub/) AND that operator override via `--config <path>` is supported.

Implement Redactor that scrubs absolute paths in JSON + HTML artifact content. Replaces `<absolute_repo_root>` with `.` (repo-relative root) before write. Replaces other `/Users/<user>/` patterns with `<redacted>` (defense-in-depth for unrelated paths that might leak through module docstrings or schema descriptions). Mirrors the Plan 4 F002 D004 escape pattern: validate output post-redaction; raise RedactorError with operator-actionable message if any `/Users/` substring survives.

Wire NEW `--plans-root <path>` flag on doctor's validate-plans-strict probe in scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py + scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py: the underlying validate_plans_strict() function already accepts plans_root per Plan 3 F003 (commit c104c22 — the test test_orchestrate_cli_advisory_mode_returns_0_with_warn_findings monkeypatches PLANS_ROOT directly); add CLI flag that passes through. Default behavior unchanged (no flag = walks DontPanic's own plans_root). New test: validate-plans-strict with --plans-root=<external_tmp_path> walks the external dir without leaking DontPanic's plans.

Wire NEW `--architecture-json <path>` flag on doctor's architecture-drift probe (Plan 4 F003 ships the probe; commit c4e9034) in scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py + cli.py: today the probe reads from a fixed relative path; add flag that overrides. Default behavior unchanged. New test: architecture-drift with --architecture-json=<external_path> evaluates drift against the external snapshot.

Implement showcase Generator that: (1) parses --config or uses DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_CONFIG; (2) for each target — checks repo_root exists, emits 'skipping' if not; (3) for each supported_artifact — invokes the appropriate underlying capability via its CLI/Python API; (4) runs Redactor pass over generated content; (5) writes atomically to docs/showcase/<repo_key>-<artifact>.{html,json}; (6) returns ShowcaseResult per-target per-artifact (success/skipped/failed) + elapsed_s.

Output: pretty terminal (per-target per-artifact chip + elapsed_s) + --json (structured ShowcaseResult array). Exit code: 0=all attempted artifacts succeeded or skipped-with-clear-reason, 1=any generation failed (real defect), 2=unrecoverable env blocker (e.g. docs/showcase/ not writable).

Update scripts/sanitization_check.py ALLOWED_PREFIXES to include 'docs/showcase/' + ensure existing secret-shape scan applies (no exemption for the new dir). Add a secret-shape pattern for Discord webhook URLs if not already covered (some downstream repos may have these in their module docstrings or env doc).

Wire `dontpanic showcase regen` CLI subcommand in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py with flags: --target=<repo_key> (filter to one target), --all (attempt all configured), --config <path> (override default config), --json. Default invocation = --all.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_showcase_generator_f001.py covering: (1) TargetSpec dataclass field validation + supported_artifacts frozenset; (2) Generator with all 4 targets present generates expected artifact set; (3) Generator with missing target_repo_root emits 'skipping' and continues; (4) Redactor scrubs `/Users/bayesian/` from sample HTML + JSON content; (5) Redactor raises RedactorError when `/Users/` substring survives (post-validation fail-fast); (6) sanitization_check still passes with docs/showcase/ allowed; (7) --plans-root flag on doctor walks external dir; (8) --architecture-json flag on doctor evaluates external snapshot; (9) supported_artifacts filter — generator skips drift for targets without has_committed_architecture_json=True without emitting an error; (10) --target=<repo_key> filter generates only that target's artifacts.

Add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_showcase_cli_integration.py: spawn `python -m dontpanic_orchestrate showcase regen --target=dontpanic --json` as subprocess against synthetic fixture; assert JSON output structure + exit code + that artifacts land under docs/showcase/. Use a tmp DONTPANIC_HOME-style isolation so test artifacts don't leak into committed docs/showcase/.

Run showcase regen against the live DontPanic checkout + agent-conventions + axiom + one of {spindine, glam} as the implementation evidence step. Commit the 4 generated artifact sets to docs/showcase/. (Operator-pickable target for the SpinDine|Glam choice is documented in features acceptance.)
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check. Confirm no regressions vs lock-time baseline.
features.acceptance: (1) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/showcase/__init__.py + config.py expose showcase_main(argv) entry + TargetSpec dataclass + DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_CONFIG with 4+ targets. (2) Generator handles per-target supported_artifacts: architecture (all targets), validate_plans_strict (targets with has_dontpanic_plans=True), drift (targets with has_committed_architecture_json=True). (3) NEW `--plans-root` CLI flag wire-through on doctor's validate-plans-strict probe (default behavior unchanged). (4) NEW `--architecture-json` CLI flag wire-through on doctor's architecture-drift probe (default behavior unchanged). (5) Redactor scrubs absolute paths to repo-relative form BEFORE write; raises RedactorError if `/Users/` survives. (6) scripts/sanitization_check.py ALLOWED_PREFIXES includes 'docs/showcase/'; secret-shape scan applies. (7) Missing target_repo_root → 'skipping' + continue (test fixture covers). (8) v0 commits ≥4 target artifact sets: dontpanic (architecture+validate+drift), agent-conventions (architecture + validate if plans), axiom (architecture only), one of {spindine, glam} (architecture + validate if plans — operator picks). (9) New test modules: test_showcase_generator_f001.py (>=10 cases) + test_showcase_cli_integration.py (CLI surface). (10) Full sweep at or above lock-time baseline; sanitization clean (NO leaked absolute paths or secrets in committed showcase artifacts).

features.description: Showcase docs + README integration + operator wrapper. Write docs/showcase/README.md as the index page: per artifact, list label + description + link to HTML/JSON + exact regen command. 'Coming soon' section lists future artifact types (install report → Plan 2 F004; state projection sample → Plan 003; work-request/intake → Plan 4.5) as forward references with owning plan IDs. Repo-root README.md gains a 'See DontPanic on real repos' section linking to docs/showcase/README.md with 2-3 bullet teasers (e.g. 'Visual architecture map of agent-conventions'). Create scripts/showcase.sh (operator one-line wrapper) + Makefile target `make showcase` that both invoke `python -m dontpanic_orchestrate showcase regen --all`. Document the deferral policy: docs/showcase/README.md ends with a 'Local integration — deferred' section listing the three concrete triggers for promoting a repo from showcase-only to local subtree/CI integration, so the team has a clear signal for when local integration becomes load-bearing.
steps: Read commit history for Plan 4 F002 (architecture_html.py style baseline) + Plan 4 F005 (pre-commit hook integration pattern) — informs the docs/showcase/README.md visual + tone (joyful but text-only; HTML artifacts carry the visuals).

Write docs/showcase/README.md with sections: (1) intro ('See DontPanic used on real repos'); (2) per-artifact entries grouped by target — DontPanic (architecture + validate-plans + drift links), agent-conventions (architecture + validate-plans), axiom (architecture), SpinDine|Glam (architecture + validate-plans); each entry has label + description + link to .html + link to .json + the exact regen command (`python -m dontpanic_orchestrate showcase regen --target=<repo_key>`); (3) 'Coming soon' section listing install report (Plan 2 F004), state projection sample (Plan 003), work-request/intake (Plan 4.5); (4) 'Local integration — deferred' section codifying the three triggers from this plan's forbidden_decisions; (5) regen-all wrapper invocation (`make showcase` or `scripts/showcase.sh`).

Edit repo-root README.md: add 'See DontPanic on real repos' section pointing at docs/showcase/README.md with 2-3 teaser bullets (architecture map for agent-conventions, architecture map for axiom, etc.). Keep the section short — the docs/showcase/README.md is the destination.

Create scripts/showcase.sh: shebang + set -euo pipefail + cd into repo root (via $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)) + exec `python -m dontpanic_orchestrate showcase regen --all "$@"` so operator can pass through additional args.

Create or update Makefile with `showcase` target: `make showcase` → `python -m dontpanic_orchestrate showcase regen --all`. If no Makefile exists at repo root, create one with just the showcase target + a `.PHONY: showcase` declaration (don't add unrelated targets in v0).

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_showcase_docs_f002.py covering: (1) docs/showcase/README.md exists; (2) README.md contains 'See DontPanic on real repos' section; (3) docs/showcase/README.md mentions each committed artifact (by checking the per-target links exist); (4) docs/showcase/README.md has 'Coming soon' section referencing the 3 forward plans (Plan 2 F004, Plan 003, Plan 4.5) by their plan IDs; (5) docs/showcase/README.md has 'Local integration — deferred' section listing the 3 triggers; (6) scripts/showcase.sh is executable and invokes the showcase regen command; (7) `make showcase` target exists in Makefile.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check.
